description:
Read this shop's totals in one call: its listings counted by status, and their views and leads.

Deleted listings are not counted. The totals cover each listing's whole life, not a date range.

Returns `summary` with `total_listings`, `active`, `sold`, `hidden`, `held`, `total_views` and `total_leads`. For per-listing, per-day figures over a date range, use analytics_listings.
name: analytics_summary

active.description: Listings on sale now, checked or still waiting for eno's check

held.description: Of the active listings, those still waiting for eno's check and not yet public

hidden.description: Listings taken off the site but not deleted; set_listing_status active can put one back unless eno took it down

sold.description: Listings marked sold, still shown on the site as sold

total_leads.description: Leads across all its listings, all time: signed-in buyers who opened the seller's contact, counted once per listing

total_listings.description: All of the shop's listings that are not deleted, in any status, expired ones included; so it can be more than active + sold + hidden

total_views.description: Page views across all its listings, all time

title: Get shop analytics summary
